findings.evidence: Final plan includes MSBuild.dll but omits Microsoft.Build.dll, Microsoft.Build.Tasks.Core.dll and NuGet.Build.Tasks.dll. Current binding observations stand; expand future input coverage and disclose the historical hash boundary.
Execution preflight checks precede the try/finally capture block, so input drift can exit without a portable stop record. Retain such failures without launching targets.
Parent benign-process reproduction wrote a command receipt then failed its post-check; Qualification.commands remained empty. Record launched work even when a later check raises.

Parent benign child deliberately changed groups; it remained alive after the original group cleanup. Its observed PID/start identity was recorded and parent cleaned it afterward. Terminate known survivors and verify final state.
Parent mocked-stream reproduction with runtime description 10.0.13 and a preflight failure launched both cases. Classify runtime/preflight failures as fatal and stop the second case.
Preparation checks feed bytes, but later inputs omit them and the sandbox mounts their work tree writable. Enforce read-only prepared feed and retain its bindings.

Package/assets guards do not inspect direct Reference/HintPath binaries. The import records ReferencePath without rejecting external Hexalith assemblies; validate those existing compiler inputs against verified source outputs.

The probe records returned identities but the driver accepts complete without comparing resolved path/hash to the seal. Validate existing resolved observations; independently observed successful bindings already match the sealed files.

Current verifier tests stop at receipt validation or call safe_name only. Add valid synthetic outer-hash fixtures exercising duplicate manifest/tar paths, special/missing/corrupt members and a valid capsule.

text=auto can convert new harness/JSON/Markdown bytes on checkout, breaking fixed hashes. Add narrow serialization attributes for this artifact family; operational build/runtime configuration stays unchanged.
Parent Popen-OSError reproduction emitted no command receipt. Capture argv/environment and explicit not-launched status before returning the failed launch.
Parent polling-interruption reproduction left its benign child running until parent cleanup. Ensure unconditional owned-child cleanup and retain interruption evidence before archiving.

main finally calls finish then archive without handling finish failure; state/store observation errors can prevent outcome/archive creation. Retain observation failure as unknown and still seal available evidence.

Pre-verified gap: testVerifierRejectsUnsafeAndDuplicatePaths never invokes verify with duplicate tar members. Removing the duplicate-member check would not fail existing tests; add a valid-hash duplicate-member fixture.

scope: Post-execution harness/test/report corrections only; no new SDK/build/compiler/loader run; immutable execution capsules preserved.
